evals.prompt: After a user resets their password, show a screen asking them to add a recovery phone number, text them a 6-digit code to confirm it, and only if the code is right save the number on the user in `user_metadata.recovery_phone`. Auth0 should send the text message; we do not use Twilio. There is no Auth0 tenant available in this environment. Do not run `auth0`, `curl` or any other command against a tenant. Only write files in the current directory: `vault-connection.json`, `flow-send.json`, `flow-verify.json`, `form.json`, `action.js` and `commands.yaml`. `commands.yaml` must list the exact commands you would run, in the order to run them, as a list under `steps:`, and must end with whatever it takes to make the Action actually run for users.
evals.expected_output: action.js uses onExecutePostChallenge and onContinuePostChallenge with api.prompt.render; flows use OTP GENERATE_CODE, AUTH0 SEND_SMS (no vault connection) and VERIFY_CODE, then UPDATE_USER with the AUTH0 vault connection; commands bind the Action to password-reset-post-challenge after deploying it.
assertions: Uses the post-challenge handlers, not post-login
Action is deployed and bound to the password-reset-post-challenge trigger
Each screen starts with a RICH_TEXT title and description

graders.description: Action renders on the password reset trigger
Action resumes with the post-challenge handler
does not use the post-login handler
sends with the native AUTH0 SEND_SMS action
no Twilio integration (a comment that mentions Twilio is fine)
deploys the Action, then binds it
personalizes the screen with a RICH_TEXT title and description
